item.title: Organising Sustainable Health and Care: Resilience, Adaptation and Transformation in an Era of Polycrisis
item.content:encoded:
Catherine Pope, University of Oxford

Jeffrey Braithwaite, Macquarie University

This special issue examines how health and care organisations achieve sustainability amid interconnected crises. Rather than viewing sustainability as a technical endpoint, the issue conceptualises it as an ongoing organisational accomplishment shaped by people, resources, power relations and institutional conditions. Papers should explain how organisations respond to overlapping crises, manage complexity in practice and navigate the processes through which sustainability is or is not realised.

The special issue extends the 2026 OBHC Conference conversation on sustaining change in complex systems while using health resources responsibly. It seeks theoretically ambitious and empirically grounded work that moves beyond identifying sustainability needs to reveal the actual organisational mechanisms, practices and conditions enabling or preventing sustainable action in contemporary health systems.

Appel publié par Journal of Health Organization and Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
